messages:
amanda: quick heads-up — tonight's change window: doors open 23:00 PT, silent freeze at 23:30 PT. if you need an exemption, drop it here before 21:30 PT :hourglass_flowing_sand:
jorge: noted. are we still pinning the new embeddings rollout or running gradual traffic shift?
deploy-bot: pin created: v3.4.2 -> prod (canary 10% -> 100% by policy). pin_id=pin_20240310_1798764321
laura: can we hold at 10% until smoke tests finish? I want to validate reorder latency on region eu-west1.
amanda: yes, hold at canary. laura and mike own smoke. mike can you run the perf checklist at 22:30 PT?
mike: yep — I'll run the checklist and post results. quick note: release notes still need the embeddings caveats + known perf regressions section.
release-manager: i'll publish a short note (customer-facing) by 20:45 PT. internal notes with rollout matrix in the docs repo — pinged ops for the DAG link.
qa-jen: regression harness kicked off against canary. expecting basic pass/fail by 22:10 PT. will flag immediately if failures.
sre-oncall: rollback criteria we agreed earlier: if error rate >1% sustained for 5m OR P95 latency increases >1.5x baseline for 10m, initiate rollback to v3.4.1. also if memory OOMs spike in any host.
laura: adding: if embeddings mismatch rate (top-k diff) >2% on eval set, pause rollout and triage.
amanda: exemption process: post request with owner, reason, and fallback. i.e. "exempt: repo-imports — owner @jorge — reason: late hotfix — fallback: immediate unpin to v3.4.1". i'll ack or deny within 30m.
jorge: filing exemption for minor schema tweak in transformer loader. will include test link.
ops-bot: scheduled maintenance window note: network config push @ 23:15 PT (4m duration). Impact: config reload only, no instance restarts.
mike: smoke results: passed core latency checks, p50/p95 within baseline. small error spike (~0.3%) for 2m that recovered. attaching logs: ```curl -sS https://internal-smoke/results/1798764321 | jq .summary```
qa-jen: regression harness: 2 failing prompts, both appear unrelated (downstream tokenization edge). triage started.
sre-oncall: thanks for flag. if failures look unrelated, we can continue warm canary but do not progress past 25% until addressed.
laura: can we set deploybot to auto-rollback threshold to the above criteria? less manual noise.
amanda: yes — deploy-bot, please enable auto-rollback for pin_id=pin_20240310_1798764321 with criteria: err_rate>1% for 5m OR p95>1.5x for 10m.
deploy-bot: auto-rollback: enabled for pin_20240310_1798764321. alerts routed to #release-war-room and @sre-oncall.
release-manager: release notes posted: https://docs/internal/releases/3.4.2 — includes known perf caveats and rollback plan. customer blurb scheduled for 23:45 PT.
jorge: exemption request submitted: transformer-loader schema shim. details: https://pr.internal/4567 — tests green on staging. requesting exemption to apply hotfix at 23:10 PT pre-freeze.
amanda: acked. exemption approved conditional on passing staged smoke at 23:05 PT.
mike: staged smoke (23:05) — pass. no regressions observed.
qa-jen: triage on the 2 failing prompts concluded: root cause tokenizer mismatch in a very old dataset. won't affect runtime. marking as wontfix for this rollout.
laura: proceeding to push canary -> 25% at 23:40 PT per schedule if no regressions before then.
sre-oncall: checklist before full traffic: confirm circuit-breakers configured, traffic-shed alarms in PagerDuty set to 1min notifications, and fallback routing tested.
amanda: all done. i've posted the quiet-window contact list and who calls rollback in the release channel.
ops-bot: reminder: change window lock in effect at 23:30 PT. only approved exemptions allowed to merge to prod.
jorge: hotfix merged and observed in canary logs. metrics looking stable. :tada:
mike: canary at 25% now (23:42 PT). monitoring for 15m.
sre-oncall: monitoring: no error spikes. p95 stable. continuing hold for 15m.
laura: thumbs — will run extended trace sample at 23:55 PT and share any anomalies.
deploy-bot: canary -> 100% rollout started (policy: 25% -> 50% -> 100% step) by automation. expect ~7m per step.
amanda: team — if anything deviates, call for rollback immediately. otherwise i'll announce release complete at +1h. :mega:
release-manager: scheduled postmortem window set for tomorrow 10:00 PT to review telemetry and any customer feedback.
qa-jen: final note — don't forget to tag the release branch with the hotfix tag `v3.4.2-hotfix-20240310` after it's stable.
laura: trace sample looks clean. no tails. good to finish rollout.
sre-oncall: final check — all green. no action.
amanda: marking release as complete. thanks everyone. :rocket:
